subject.title: feat(ui): unify new-thread draft and incognito into one visibility control

question: Should the Control UI permanently consolidate the existing Draft and Incognito session-visibility choices into mutually exclusive composer-footer pills?
rationale: The code preserves existing backend modes, but the control placement, wording, and interaction model are deliberate user-facing product choices; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human decision.

options.title: Accept the unified visibility control
options.body: Approve the mutually exclusive footer pills because they prevent the invalid Draft-plus-Incognito combination while retaining the existing Gateway contract.

options.title: Keep separate controls
options.body: Request a revised PR if Draft must remain associated with the target-selection row or needs a distinct interaction model.

recommendation.title: Accept the unified visibility control
recommendation.body: Approve the mutually exclusive footer pills because they prevent the invalid Draft-plus-Incognito combination while retaining the existing Gateway contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties steipete directly to the proposed Control UI design; broader current-main ownership could not be established from the read-only inspection environment.
